en.title: Borodin: String Quartet No. 2 – II. Scherzo (Allegro)
en.overview: This is a quick movement in 3/4 time with F major as its home key. It opens softly with a main tune in the first violin. That tune comes back in other parts and other keys. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so treat them as a guide. A computer estimate marks measure 158 as the loudest point, where all four players share the tune.

listening_points.headline: The main tune opens softly in the first violin
listening_points.text: The first violin plays the main tune softly, and the others accompany it [m. 1-2]. The tune comes back at the same pitch a few bars later [m. 9-10]. The first violin leads here.

listening_points.headline: Darker minor colours, then a swell
listening_points.text: The key turns to F minor, which sounds darker [m. 17-23]. The marking fz asks for sharp accents [m. 21]. Then the music swells [m. 25] and reaches a brief loud moment at f [m. 26].

listening_points.headline: A slower, quiet passage
listening_points.text: The marking changes to larghetto, which means a slower pace. The music stays soft. The texture changes often, with independent lines at times [m. 29, m. 35-36]. The lead is probably shared between the first violin and cello. The key moves to E minor near the end [m. 33-36].

listening_points.headline: Back to tempo, with shifting keys
listening_points.text: The original speed returns. The music passes through E major, B major and A major [m. 37-50]. Each change gives the music a new colour. Mostly the lines are independent, so no single part clearly has the tune.

listening_points.headline: The viola takes up the main tune
listening_points.text: The viola plays the main tune, pitched lower than at the start, in G major [m. 51-52]. It plays it again [m. 55-56]. Then it plays it in C major [m. 59-60]. The level is mf at first, then p.

listening_points.headline: A build to loud, cello solos, and a silence
listening_points.text: The music swells [m. 72-73] and becomes loud at f [m. 76]. The cello plays alone [m. 85] and again [m. 89]. The violins then trade the lead bar by bar [m. 90-95]. The level reaches ff [m. 96], with players in unison or octaves [m. 97]. Then comes a stretch of tacet, meaning nobody plays [m. 98-99].

listening_points.headline: Soft again, with the lead passed around
listening_points.text: The music is soft, at p, from here [m. 100]. The marking Tempo I. (back to the opening speed) appears at [m. 97]. The viola and second violin trade the lead [m. 100-110]. The key moves through B-flat major, F minor, E-flat major and B-flat minor [m. 105-122].

listening_points.headline: Vivace: moving through darker keys
listening_points.text: The marking changes to vivace, which means lively. The music swells at the start [m. 126]. It passes through F minor and then C minor [m. 129-142]. The lead moves between the violins. The stretch ends in F-sharp major [m. 143].

listening_points.headline: Cello tune, then a louder first violin
listening_points.text: The cello probably leads, softly, in F-sharp major and then D-flat major [m. 144-151]. Then the first violin takes over, loud at f [m. 152-157]. Its lead is clear.

listening_points.headline: Estimated peak: the main tune in all four parts
listening_points.text: A computer estimate marks measure 158 as the loudest point, at ff. All four instruments play the main tune together in unison or octaves, in A-flat major [m. 158-159]. After that the level is mp, which is moderately soft [m. 160].

listening_points.headline: Soft again, then a loud burst and a pause
listening_points.text: The music is soft again in F major, then D minor [m. 164-176]. The violins trade the lead [m. 178-185]. The music then reaches ff [m. 186]. The marking presto means very fast [m. 187]. A tacet bar follows [m. 189].

listening_points.headline: The opening tune returns at its original pitch
listening_points.text: Tempo I. brings back the main tune in the first violin, soft and at the same pitch as the start [m. 192-193]. It comes again in F major [m. 200-201]. Later the key darkens to B-flat minor [m. 210-216].

listening_points.headline: Faster, then the viola tune returns loudly
listening_points.text: The marking becomes molto allegro, which means very fast [m. 221]. The music passes through A minor, E major and D major [m. 228-243]. Then the viola brings the main tune back in C major, loud at f [m. 244-249].

listening_points.headline: Hush, then a swell and a fall
listening_points.text: The viola plays the tune softly in F major [m. 252-253]. The level falls to pp, very soft [m. 255]. Then it swells [m. 256, m. 260] and reaches f [m. 262]. It is p again in minor keys [m. 269].

listening_points.headline: Vivace: a loud, confident first violin
listening_points.text: Vivace returns, loud at f. The first violin clearly leads in F major while the others accompany [m. 277-284]. Then the viola plays alone [m. 286]. The key shifts to B-flat minor.

listening_points.headline: A quiet fade back to F major
listening_points.text: Tempo I. returns, with accents marked fp and a fading marking. Single instruments play alone in turn [m. 290, m. 294, m. 296]. The key returns to F major [m. 294]. The level goes from mp to p and finally pp, so the movement ends very softly [m. 295-299].

glossary.explanation: The opening tune, which returns in different parts and keys.
The home note and scale of the music. Major keys sound brighter. Minor keys sound darker.
Instruments play the same tune together, at the same pitch or at different octaves.
A part or the whole group is silent.
A marking to go back to the opening speed.
fz is a sharp accent. fp is loud, then quickly soft.
Speed words: slowish, lively, very fast, and very quick.

zh.title: 鲍罗丁《第二弦乐四重奏》第二乐章 谐谑曲 听赏指南
zh.overview: 本乐章是 3/4 拍的谐谑曲，主调为 F 大调，共 299 小节。开头由第一小提琴奏出主要主题，之后它会在不同声部和不同调里再次出现。请留意速度标记的变化、各声部轮流领奏，以及强弱的对比。电脑估计最响、最忙的一点在第 158 小节。本指南中的调性与和弦都是软件自动估计的，可能有误。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴轻声唱出主要主题
listening_points.text: 乐章以弱（p）开始，F 大调。第一小提琴奏出主要主题，其余声部伴奏 [m. 1-2]。第 9 小节主题以同样的音高再次出现 [m. 9-10]。

listening_points.headline: 转入 F 小调，音色变暗，出现突强
listening_points.text: 第 17 小节起转到 F 小调，气氛变暗 [m. 17-23]。第 21 小节出现 fz，即突然加重的一下。第 25 小节标有渐强，第 26 小节变强（f）[m. 25-26]。

listening_points.headline: 慢下来的“较宽广”段落
listening_points.text: 第 29 小节进入 larghetto，速度放慢。织体变化较多，有时各声部各走各的线条。音乐保持弱奏。第 33 小节转到 E 小调 [m. 33-36]。

listening_points.headline: 回到原速，调性频繁变动
listening_points.text: 第 37 小节恢复原速（a tempo）。调性从 E 大调经 B 大调走到 A 大调 [m. 37-50]。声部多为各唱各的旋律线，领奏者不明确，更像大家共同分担。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴接过主题
listening_points.text: 第 51 小节起，中提琴奏出主要主题，音高与开头不同 [m. 51-52]。第 55 小节再来一次 [m. 55-56]。第 59 小节它又在 C 大调里出现 [m. 59-60]。前一段是中强（mf），第 59 小节转为弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 变强，大提琴独奏，直到很强
listening_points.text: 第 76 小节变强（f）。第 85 小节大提琴独奏 [m. 85]。第 90 到 95 小节两把小提琴轮流领奏 [m. 90-95]。第 96 小节很强（ff），第 97 小节是齐奏，即各声部奏同一旋律 [m. 96-97]。

listening_points.headline: 休止之后，轻轻的对话
listening_points.text: 第 98 到 99 小节分析显示无声部演奏（tacet）。Tempo I. 从第 97 小节起标出，第 100 小节转为弱（p）。中提琴和第二小提琴一小节一小节地交替领奏 [m. 100-110]。

listening_points.headline: 两把小提琴交替，调性一路转换
listening_points.text: 这里两把小提琴一小节接一小节地轮流领奏 [m. 115-125]。调性经过降 B 大调、降 E 大调和降 B 小调 [m. 112-125]。整段保持弱奏，并标有渐弱。

listening_points.headline: 活泼的 vivace，类似的小乐句反复出现
listening_points.text: 第 126 小节进入 vivace，标有渐强。随后在 F 小调和 C 小调里，类似的小乐句一再出现，领奏在两把小提琴间变换 [m. 128-142]。这段为中强（mf），每隔四小节有一下很强（ff）的标记，随即回到中强 [m. 128-140]。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴先领，然后第一小提琴转强
listening_points.text: 第 144 小节回到原速，弱奏，大提琴领奏 [m. 144-151]。调性转到升 F 大调，再到降 D 大调。第 152 小节变强（f），第一小提琴领奏 [m. 152-157]。

listening_points.headline: 电脑估计的高潮：四件乐器齐奏主题
listening_points.text: 第 158 到 159 小节，四个声部以齐奏奏出主要主题，音量为很强（ff）。分析标记第 158 小节为最响最忙的一点，这是电脑估计。第 160 小节减弱为中弱（mp），中提琴和大提琴可能共同领奏，其余伴奏。

listening_points.headline: 重音点缀，再冲向很强与休止
listening_points.text: 第 164 小节起转弱，并出现 fp，即先强后立刻变弱，一再重复 [m. 164-176]。第 178 到 185 小节，两把小提琴清楚地轮流领奏。第 186 小节变为很强（ff），第 187 小节进入 presto，即很快的速度。第 189 小节无声部演奏 [m. 189]。

listening_points.headline: 开头的主题回来了
listening_points.text: 第 192 小节回到 Tempo I.，第一小提琴再次奏出主要主题，弱奏。主题音高与开头完全相同 [m. 192-193]；第 192 小节的调性估计标为 F 小调，但这不改变主题的音高。第 200 小节主题回到 F 大调，同样的音高 [m. 200-201]。

listening_points.headline: molto allegro，再回到多变的调性
listening_points.text: 第 221 小节进入 molto allegro，速度更快。第 230 小节起回到原速，调性经过 E 大调和 D 大调 [m. 231-243]。这里的声部大多各自独立，领奏者不明确。

listening_points.headline: 主题在中提琴再现，音量起伏
listening_points.text: 第 244 小节，中提琴在强（f）中再奏主题 [m. 244-249]。第 252 小节它又出现，这次是弱奏 [m. 252-253]。第 255 小节音量降到很弱（pp），第 256 小节起标有渐强，第 262 小节回到强（f）[m. 255-262]。

listening_points.headline: vivace 冲刺，最后安静收尾
listening_points.text: 第 269 小节转弱，第二小提琴领奏 [m. 269-276]。第 277 小节 vivace 变强（f），第一小提琴领奏 [m. 277-284]。第 286 小节中提琴独奏 [m. 286]。尾声回到 Tempo I.，最后在 F 大调中音量一级级降到很弱（pp）[m. 297-299]。

glossary.explanation: 乐曲里最容易记住、会反复出现的那段旋律。
乐曲当下以哪个音为“家”。大调偏明亮，小调偏暗淡。本指南的调性由软件估计，可能有误。
几个声部同时奏同一条旋律，可以相差八度。
fz 是突然加重一下；fp 是先强后立刻变弱。
声音逐渐变大或逐渐变小。
速度术语：larghetto 较宽广缓慢，presto 很快，vivace 活泼，molto allegro 非常快的快板。
分析显示这些小节里没有声部演奏。
